method.time: t_active is the interval union in which at least one GPU-0 kernel in the displayed node is active. Summed residency tΣ is retained as aggregate_kernel_ms; overlap_excess_ms = tΣ - t_active, and idle_gap_ms = wall_span_ms - t_active. Parent unions are computed directly; overlapping child unions are not additive.
method.mfu: MFU uses static GLM-5.2 math normalized to the dense H200 FP8 reference and divides by active_union_ms; BF16 sparse-MLA work is multiplied by two.
method.mbu: MBUmin uses a strict useful-byte floor: active weights are counted once per batch, while sequence-owned index/KV bytes scale with B. It divides by active_union_ms and is not measured DRAM traffic.
method.precision: No Nsight Compute DRAM, clock, or power counters were captured; the percentages use theoretical peak denominators.
method.classification: Layer boundaries use the repeated 2,048-wide RMSNorm anchors and the sole output fused RMSNorm. The MLA-combine/TP-reduction motif separates attention from overlapped FFN nodes; every graph node reconciles exactly once.
method.moe_bytes: Routed expert IDs were not captured, so the expert-weight byte numerator assumes maximum reuse and is only a strict lower bound.
